newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES EASE TO END AT 19.625 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES EASE TO END AT 19.625 PCT.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates ended a shade easier on Thursday at 19.625 percent after routine trading, traders said.
Overnight rates traded in a narrow range of between 19.50 and 19.625 percent compared with Wednesday's close of 19.75 percent.
Interbank overnight rates hovered between 19.50 and 20.00 percent in abundant money supply and moderate activity since the beginning of the banks' two-week reserve period on August 1.
